prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Draw a polished high fidelity UI concept board for a Chinese digital library AI chat sidebar. Show two full-height 320px-wide sidebar designs side by side: left empty welcome state, right active conversation state. Clean flat actual web UI, no device mockup, no perspective, no decorative background, no annotations. Pale warm off-white surface, dark charcoal text, subtle gray borders, restrained deep teal accent, generous whitespace, elegant compact professional typography. Each sidebar about 700px tall. Compact 48px header with a tiny teal owl/open-book logo at left, exact title "阅读助手", and small new-conversation icon button at right. Immediately below one subtle breadcrumb line "人类简史 · 第三章" with truncated text. Empty state: small 48px owl logo above short title "想聊聊这本书？", three compact suggestion pill buttons stacked with text "概括这一章", "解释关键概念", "这段话怎么理解？"; calm centered layout, no paragraph of instructions. Active conversation: right-aligned soft teal user bubble "这一章的核心观点是什么？"; assistant reply as plain left-aligned readable prose with no enclosing bubble and no repeated avatars or role labels: "这一章讨论了人类如何通过共同想象建立大规模协作。\n\n语言不仅用于描述现实，也让陌生人相信同一个故事。" Below reply a tiny collapsed citation disclosure row "参考来源 · 2" with chevron. No timestamps, no model names. Bottom of each sidebar: one rounded bordered composer box with short placeholder "问问这本书…", modest two-line height, circular dark teal upward-arrow send button inside lower right. Beneath box only muted tiny text "Enter 发送". Precision UI design, beautiful spacing, minimal text.
